Guides to dog day outs, sleepovers and shelter volunteering

⁠​⁢⁢​⁢‌​‌⁢‌⁢⁢‍⁢‌​⁠Everything you need to take a shelter dog out for the day, host a sleepover, hike with a shelter dog or volunteer.

Want to rent a dog for the day? Borrow a shelter dog instead

Want to rent a dog or puppy for a day? Many shelters let you borrow or foster a dog for a day free: a few hours, a hike or a sleepover. Find one near you.

Doggy day out programs near you

Find a doggy day out program near you: take an adoptable shelter dog out for the day, free. Every dog day out program we know of, checked monthly.

Foster a dog for a day or a weekend

Foster a shelter dog for a day, a night or a weekend. Find short-term foster, day trip and sleepover programs near you, free and checked monthly.

Volunteer at an animal shelter near you

How to volunteer at an animal shelter near you: dog walking, day trips, sleepovers and cat socializing. Find shelters with volunteer outing programs.

Have a sleepover with a shelter dog

Host a shelter dog for a night, a weekend or a staycation. Find shelter dog sleepover programs near you, free and checked monthly.

Take a shelter dog hiking

Take an adoptable shelter dog hiking or for a long walk. Find shelter trail buddy and field trip programs near you, free and checked monthly.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.

Ready to adopt? ShelterAdoption, our sister site, lists every shelter near you plus upcoming adoption events.
